reden: Yes. The report’s “[High] Liquidation reward uses futureValue (borrow-token units) but is added to collateral-token amounts” is the same issue as H-04. Both point to executeLiquidate in Liquidate.sol, where liquidatorReward incorrectly uses debtPosition.futureValue (USDC units) alongside collateral-denominated values (WETH units), making the reward ~1e12 too small. Both impacts are that liquidations aren’t incentivized. The specific fix in both is to base the reward on the converted debtInCollateralToken (collateral units) instead of futureValue. Fixing the report’s issue would fix H-04.
